{
  "plan": "# Fix Board Unresponsiveness Issues\n\n## Problem Analysis\n\nAfter reviewing the codebase, I've identified several issues that can cause the board to appear unresponsive:\n\n1. **Silent Exception Handling**: Many &#96;edit_message_text&#96; calls are wrapped in try-except blocks that silently swallow exceptions with &#96;pass&#96;, leaving users without feedback when operations fail.\n\n2. **No Timeout Handling**: Telegram API calls don't have explicit timeouts, so if a call hangs, the handler could hang indefinitely.\n\n3. **Early &#96;query.answer()&#96; Calls**: In callback handlers, &#96;query.answer()&#96; is called at the beginning, which tells Telegram the callback was received. However, if an exception occurs after that but before the message is updated, the user sees the button as \"clicked\" but the board doesn't update.\n\n4. **Missing Error Feedback**: When &#96;edit_message_text&#96; fails silently, users don't know why the board isn't updating.\n\n5. **Race Conditions**: Multiple rapid clicks could cause race conditions where game state gets out of sync.\n\n## Solution\n\n### 1. Improve Error Handling in Callback Handlers\n\n**Files to modify:**\n- &#96;handlers.py&#96; - All callback handlers (&#96;select_callback&#96;, &#96;move_callback&#96;, &#96;back_callback&#96;, &#96;forfeit_callback&#96;)\n\n**Changes:**\n- Wrap critical operations in try-except blocks with proper error logging\n- Only call &#96;query.answer()&#96; after successful validation, or provide error feedback\n- Add user-facing error messages when operations fail\n- Log exceptions with context (user_id, chat_id, game_state) for debugging\n\n### 2. Add Timeout Handling for Telegram API Calls\n\n**Files to modify:**\n- &#96;handlers.py&#96; - &#96;_update_game_message&#96;, &#96;_update_inline_game_message&#96;, and all &#96;edit_message_text&#96; calls\n\n**Changes:**\n- Use &#96;asyncio.wait_for()&#96; with a timeout (e.g., 10 seconds) for all Telegram API calls\n- Catch &#96;asyncio.TimeoutError&#96; and log it appropriately\n- Provide fallback behavior when timeouts occur\n\n### 3. Improve Update Message Methods\n\n**Files to modify:**\n- &#96;handlers.py&#96; - &#96;_update_game_message&#96; and &#96;_update_inline_game_message&#96;\n\n**Changes:**\n- Replace silent &#96;pass&#96; exceptions with proper error logging\n- Add retry logic for transient failures\n- Return success/failure status to callers\n- Log specific error types (network errors, rate limits, etc.)\n\n### 4. Add Request Deduplication/Throttling\n\n**Files to modify:**\n- &#96;handlers.py&#96; - Callback handlers\n\n**Changes:**\n- Add a simple in-memory cache to track recent callback queries\n- Ignore duplicate callbacks within a short time window (e.g., 500ms)\n- Prevent race conditions from rapid clicking\n\n### 5. Enhanced Logging\n\n**Files to modify:**\n- &#96;handlers.py&#96; - All callback handlers\n\n**Changes:**\n- Add structured logging with context (user_id, chat_id, action, timing)\n- Log all exceptions with full stack traces\n- Add performance timing for critical operations\n- Log when operations succeed vs fail\n\n## Implementation Details\n\n### Error Handling Pattern\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\nasync def callback_handler(self, update, context):\n    query = update.callback_query\n    try:\n        # Validate first\n        game_state = self._get_game_state(...)\n        if not game_state:\n            await query.answer(\"Гру не знайдено\", show_alert=True)\n            return\n        \n        # Process operation\n        result = await self._process_operation(...)\n        \n        # Only answer after success\n        await query.answer()\n        await self._update_board(...)\n        \n    except asyncio.TimeoutError:\n        logger.error(f\"Timeout updating board for user {query.from_user.id}\")\n        await query.answer(\"⏱️ Операція зайняла занадто багато часу. Спробуйте ще раз.\", show_alert=True)\n    except Exception as e:\n        logger.exception(f\"Error in callback handler: user={query.from_user.id}, error={e}\")\n        await query.answer(\"❌ Сталася помилка. Спробуйте ще раз.\", show_alert=True)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Timeout Wrapper\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\nasync def safe_edit_message(bot, timeout=10, **kwargs):\n    try:\n        return await asyncio.wait_for(\n            bot.edit_message_text(**kwargs),\n            timeout=timeout\n        )\n    except asyncio.TimeoutError:\n        logger.error(f\"Timeout editing message: {kwargs}\")\n        raise\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Deduplication\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\n# Simple in-memory cache (can be moved to Redis for multi-instance)\n_recent_callbacks = {}  # {callback_id: timestamp}\n\ndef is_duplicate_callback(callback_id, window_ms=500):\n    now = time.time() * 1000\n    if callback_id in _recent_callbacks:\n        if now - _recent_callbacks[callback_id] &lt; window_ms:\n            return True\n    _recent_callbacks[callback_id] = now\n    return False\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Testing Strategy\n\n1. Test rapid clicking to ensure deduplication works\n2. Test with simulated network delays/timeouts\n3. Test error scenarios (deleted messages, invalid game states)\n4. Monitor logs to ensure errors are properly logged\n5. Verify user feedback is provided in all error cases\n\n## Files to Modify\n\n- &#96;handlers.py&#96; - Main changes to callback handlers and update methods\n- Consider adding a utility module for timeout handling if needed\n\n## Expected Outcomes\n\n- Users receive clear feedback when operations fail\n- Board updates are more reliable with timeout handling\n- Better debugging with enhanced logging\n- Reduced race conditions from rapid clicking\n- Improved user experience with proper error messages",

+     async def _update_game_message(self, message, engine: CheckersEngine, game_state: dict, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE = None, selected_pos: Optional[int] = None) -&gt; bool:
+         """
+         Update game message with current board and turn info.
+         Returns True if successful, False otherwise.
+         """
+         try:
+             board_text = BoardRenderer.render(engine.board)
+             players_msg = self._get_players_message(game_state)
+             turn_msg = self._get_turn_message(game_state)
+             keyboard = BoardRenderer.create_move_keyboard(
+                 engine,
+                 selected_pos=selected_pos,
+                 move_count=engine.move_count,
+                 pending_capture=game_state.get("pending_capture")
+             )
+             
+             message_text = f"{players_msg}\n\n{board_text}\n\n{turn_msg}"
+             
+             # Check if this is an inline message
+             if game_state.get("is_inline") and context:
+                 inline_message_id = game_state.get("inline_message_id")
+                 if inline_message_id:
+                     return await self._update_inline_game_message(context.bot, inline_message_id, engine, game_state)
+             
+             # For private matches, update both players' messages
+             if game_state.get("is_private_match") and context:
+                 success = True
+                 try:
+                     # Update opponent's message
+                     await self._safe_edit_message(
+                         context.bot,
+                         chat_id=game_state["opponent_chat_id"],
+                         message_id=game_state["opponent_message_id"],
+                         text=message_text,
+                         reply_markup=keyboard,
+                         parse_mode="HTML"
+                     )
+                 except asyncio.TimeoutError:
+                     logger.error(f"[_update_game_message] Timeout updating opponent message: chat_id={game_state.get('opponent_chat_id')}")
+                     success = False
+                 except Exception as e:
+                     logger.warning(f"[_update_game_message] Failed to update opponent message: chat_id={game_state.get('opponent_chat_id')}, error={e}")
+                     success = False
+                 
+                 try:
+                     # Update challenger's message
+                     await self._safe_edit_message(
+                         context.bot,
+                         chat_id=game_state["challenger_chat_id"],
+                         message_id=game_state["challenger_message_id"],
+                         text=message_text,
+                         reply_markup=keyboard,
+                         parse_mode="HTML"
+                     )
+                 except asyncio.TimeoutError:
+                     logger.error(f"[_update_game_message] Timeout updating challenger message: chat_id={game_state.get('challenger_chat_id')}")
+                     success = False
+                 except Exception as e:
+                     logger.warning(f"[_update_game_message] Failed to update challenger message: chat_id={game_state.get('challenger_chat_id')}, error={e}")
+                     success = False
+                 
+                 return success
+             else:
+                 # Regular group chat - just update the one message
+                 try:
+                     await asyncio.wait_for(
+                         message.edit_text(
+                             message_text,
+                             reply_markup=keyboard,
+                             parse_mode="HTML"
+                         ),
+                         timeout=10.0
+                     )
+                     return True
+                 except asyncio.TimeoutError:
+                     logger.error(f"[_update_game_message] Timeout updating regular message")
+                     return False
+                 except Exception as e:
+                     logger.warning(f"[_update_game_message] Failed to update regular message: error={e}")
